doc.title: Ruth Brown interviewed by Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995

title: Closing remarks
summary: The interviewer concludes the session and thanks Ruth Brown.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well we’re going to conclude this portion of our interview right now. We’ve been very flattered to get some incredible information from Ruth Brown, and we hope to continue this and build this archive over several years at Hamilton College. It has been an honor.
The privilege has been mine. Thank you.
